name: standard_opener
description: The opener the Data Lab mockup assumed, played for real: storage and a refinery first, a duranium mine (else tritanium), a lab, a second refinery once ore piles up, more storage, refinery Mk II, a Vehicle Bay and a second crawler, then the Fusion Reactor once the foundry needs the power, the foundry (paused while metal is short or parasteel piles up), Colonial Administration (Mk III needs a level 2 base), then refinery Mk III once there is parasteel. The newest crawler fetches deuterium when the reactor runs low. No beams from the ship.
